build_flashinfer_mla_backend: build a FlashInferMLAAttnBackend instance for MLA attention with FlashInfer kernels in SGLang
init_forward_metadata: init forward metadata for the FlashInferMLAAttnBackend based on the current forward batch and mode
run_flashinfer_mha_chunk_kv: run MHA chunked prefix KV cache attention for models using MLA with FlashInfer ragged prefill
forward_extend: forward extend tokens through the FlashInfer MLA attention backend with paged or ragged prefill
forward_decode: forward decode a single token through the FlashInfer MLA attention backend with paged attention
